Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 실패로부터 교훈을 얻겠다고 한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vows to learn from her failure.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、失敗から教訓を得ると言う。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说要从失败中汲取教训。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說要從失敗中汲取教訓。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à la mission, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jure d'apprendre de son échec.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem Scheitern der Mission schwört <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, aus ihrem Fehler zu lernen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jura aprender de su fracaso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> jura aprender com seu erro.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ตั้งใจว่าจะเรียนรู้จากความผิดพลาดของเธอครับ/ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersumpah untuk belajar dari kegagalannya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thề sẽ rút kinh nghiệm từ thất bại của mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अपनी असफलता से सीखने का संकल्प लेती है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I see. Let's go back and think about it.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: そうだな。戻って考えてみよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 没错，我们回去再想想吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 沒錯，我們回去再想想吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Verstehe. Gehen wir zurück und denken darüber nach.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Ya veo. Volvamos y pensemos en ello.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Entendi. Vamos voltar e pensar sobre isso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เข้าใจแล้วครับ/ค่ะ กลับไปคิดทบทวนกันเถอะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Begitu. Mari kita kembali dan memikirkannya.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi hiểu rồi. Hãy quay lại và suy nghĩ về nó.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है। चलो वापस जाकर इस पर विचार करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tu veux une potion de vitalité ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อยากได้ยาเพิ่มพลังไหมครับ/คะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Muốn uống Thuốc Hồi Sức không?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: क्या आप वाइटैलिटी पोशन चाहते हैं?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 같은 실수를 반복하지 않겠다는 의지를 다졌다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> steeled herself with the resolve not to repeat the same mistake again.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は同じ過ちを繰り返さないという決意を固めた。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est forgée la résolution de ne pas répéter la même erreur.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fasste den Entschluss, denselben Fehler nicht noch einmal zu wiederholen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se armó de valor con la resolución de no repetir el mismo error.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se armou com a resolução de não repetir o mesmo erro.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตั้งใจแน่วแน่ว่าจะไม่ทำผิดพลาดซ้ำสองครับ/ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menguatkan diri dengan tekad untuk tidak mengulangi kesalahan yang sama lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hạ quyết tâm sẽ không lặp lại sai lầm tương tự nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने उसी गलती को न दोहराने का दृढ़ संकल्प किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> calmly reflected on the lessons she learned from her failure.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は失敗から学んだ教訓を静かに噛みしめた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>冷静地重新思考从失败中学到的教训。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 從<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>冷靜地重新思考從失敗中學到的教訓。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a calmement réfléchi aux leçons tirées de son échec.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dachte ruhig über die Lektionen nach, die sie aus ihrem Scheitern gelernt hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> reflexionó con calma sobre las lecciones que aprendió de su fracaso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> refletiu calmamente sobre as lições que aprendeu com seu fracasso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ทบทวนบทเรียนที่ได้จากความล้มเหลวอย่างใจเย็นครับ/ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dengan tenang merenungkan pelajaran yang dia dapat dari kegagalannya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bình tĩnh suy ngẫm về những bài học rút ra từ thất bại của mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपनी असफलता से सीखे गए सबक पर शांति से विचार किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est réjoui en recevant la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> freute sich, das Trank zu erhalten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó tras recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou após receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดีใจที่ได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को खुशी हुई।
